page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-96-lssd is a high-capacity server instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 360.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 3.75 GB of memory per core.

This instance includes integrated local storage, featuring 16 local NVMe SSDs that combine for a total capacity of 6442 GB. It does not include any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the substantial local NVMe SSD storage capacity and high dedicated CPU core count, this server is designed for storage-intensive and database workloads. The balanced memory-to-core ratio and high-density local storage make it qualitatively cost-effective for large-scale databases, data analytics, and high-throughput local I/O tasks where external storage latency must be avoided.
